action.command: echo "=== Verify ALL assets referenced in index.html ==="; curl -s http://localhost/ | grep -oE '(src|href)="[^"]+"' | grep -oE '"[^"]+"' | tr -d '"' | sort -u | while read a; do case "$a" in http*|\#|mailto:*) echo "SKIP $a";; *) code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost/$a"); echo "$code  /$a";; esac; done
